Paragraph.Text: Events are used for asynchronous, one-way communication. They are perfect for long-running tasks or system notifications.
The backend can emit an event to all windows or a specific window.
To react to these events in the UI, you set up a listener. In Leptos, you typically do this inside a
: Updating a percentage during a large file upload.
: Notifying the UI when a USB device is plugged in.
: Updating multiple windows simultaneously when a setting changes.
